text:
ben_sales: Hey team — Acme wants a hosted API key for their 2-week POC. Requirements: expire after 7 days, IP allowlist 54.12.34.0/24, billing tag acct=acme-poc. Can infra provision an ephemeral hosted key we can hand to them?

priya_se: You can self-serve short-lived keys from Console (Settings → API keys) but console UX doesn't support an automated rotation cron. For IP-restricted + automated rotation we usually have infra pre-provision and attach a rotate/revoke policy. Which do you want?

ben_sales: Prefer infra-provisioned so we can set automatic rotation every 48h and revoke at POC end without asking the customer. Also need contact name: jsmith@acme.com.

mike_infra: I can do that. Need to confirm: 1) CIDR(s) for allowlist (one or many), 2) TTL (you asked 7d?), 3) rotation cadence (48h ok), 4) billing tag. Also confirm whether they need a single key for the whole team or per-user keys.

ben_sales: CIDR is 54.12.34.0/24 only. TTL 168h (7 days). Rotation 48h. Billing tag acct=acme-poc. Single key is fine for this POC.

mike_infra: Got it. I'll provision under project `sales-pocs` and tag it so billing shows up correctly. Command I'll run (internal):
```
# preview (internal-only)
rwdctl keys create \
  --project sales-pocs \
  --ttl 168h \
  --ip-allowlist 54.12.34.0/24 \
  --tags acct=acme-poc \
  --rotate 48h \
  --owner jsmith@acme.com
```
This will set up an automated 48h rotation job and a final revocation at TTL expiry.

keybot: created key rwd_key_XXXX (masked) for project sales-pocs. Expires in 7 days. Rotation schedule: 48h. Resource ID: key-1932. Please do NOT paste the full secret in chat. :lock:

sara_ops: I'll schedule a revocation check for the POC end date and add a reminder in the POC tracker. Ben — what's the official POC end date so I can calendar it?

ben_sales: POC end date 2025-10-05. Please revoke on end date unless we extend.

ben_sales: Also quick question from Acme: if a key is suspected compromised mid-POC, what's the fastest path to rotate/revoke and get a new key without downtime?

priya_se: Two paths: 1) Infra revoke old key and create new key (zero trust) then update the client with new `X-API-Key` header. 2) If they can accept short overlap, infra can issue a new key and we update server side to accept both during swap. CLI revoke: `rwdctl keys revoke key-1932`. Replacement: `rwdctl keys create --parent key-1932 --ttl 168h --ip-allowlist 54.12.34.0/24 --tags acct=acme-poc`.

mike_infra: We'll do immediate revoke + new key in <10 minutes if needed. I'll also add the contact jsmith@acme.com as an approved requester so they can ask support to rotate quickly.

mike_infra: Note: hosted API keys are only for hosted runtime. If Acme later needs Dedicated pools or Private/VPC, we must create new credentials scoped to that environment (tokens can't be promoted).

ben_sales: Good to note — I'll mention during handoff. Anything else we need from me now?

mike_infra: Please confirm the CIDR and owner email (you already did). I'll provision and post the masked key location + audit link here when done.

keybot: audit log: key-1932 created by mike_infra at 1932104389. Tags: acct=acme-poc. Rotations scheduled every 48h. :white_check_mark:

ben_sales: :thumbsup: thanks all!
